[[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\nThis event feature two title fights, first the former ACB featherweight champion Marat Balaev will face the WFCA featherweight champion Salman Zhamaldaev to determine the ACA featherweight champion as the event headliner. And the ACB bantamweight champions Rustam Kerimov and WFCA bantamweight champions Abdul-Rakhman Dudaev will collide to unify titles and determine the ACA bantamweight champion as co-headliner.\n\nTimur Nagibin was set to fight with Lambert Akhiadov but he has to withdraw the day before the fight due to health issues. As a result of this, the fight was canceled.\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n \nThe following fighters will be awarded $10,000 bonuses:\n*'''Fight of the Night:''' Marat Balaev vs. Salman Choke)\n|align=center|3\n|align=center|3:54\n|\n|}\n\n==ACA 94: Bagov vs. Khaliev==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=ACA 94: Bagov vs. Khaliev\n|image=\n|promotion=[[Absolute Championship Akhmat]] \n|date=March 30, 2019\n|venue=[[Basket-Hall Krasnodar|Basket-Hall]]\n|city={{flagicon|RUS}} [[Krasnodar]], [[Russia]]\n|attendance= \n|gate= \n|previousevent=\n|followingevent= \n}}\n\n'''''Absolute Championship Akhmat 94: Bagov vs. Khaliev''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Absolute Championship Akhmat on March 30, 2019 at the [[Basket-Hall Krasnodar|Basket-Hall]] in [[Krasnodar]], [[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\nThis event was set to feature a unification bout between the ACB lightweight champion [[Ali Bagov]] and the WFCA lightweight champion Khusein Khaliev to determine the ACA lightweight champion as the event headliner. However at the weigh-ins, Bagov weighed in at 72 kilograms, 1.75 kilograms over the lightweight limit for a title fight. Bagov was given additional time to make weight, but he refused to do so. The ACA commission explained to Bagov that because he missed weight the bout will proceed as a non-title contest. Bagov refused to fight, that forced the fight to be cancelled. He was suspended for 6 months for breach of contract.{{cite web |url=http://www.fight-madness.com/title-fight-between-ali-bagov-and-khusein-khaliev-has-been-cancelled/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190428172039/http://www.fight-madness.com/title-fight-between-ali-bagov-and-khusein-khaliev-has-been-cancelled/|url-status=usurped|archive-date=April 28, 2019|title=Title fight between Ali Bagov and Khusein Khaliev has been cancelled.|publisher=fight-madness.com}}\n\nThe ACB heavyweight champions Mukhumat Vakhaev was set to face WFCA heavyweight champions [[Evgeniy Goncharov]] in the co-main event for ACB/WFCA unification bout. But Vakhaev was pulled from the card due to illness, that forced the fight to be cancelled.\n\nThe WFCA welterweight champion Murad Abdullaev was set to fight with the ACB welterweight champion Albert Tumenov, but Abdullaev has to withdraw due to health issues. As a result of this, the title unification fight was moved to ACA 95.\n\nAdrick Croes faced Isa Umarov at ACB 94. He replaced Nicolae Negumereanu who signed with the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] earlier this month.{{cite web |url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Nicolae-Negumereanu-Steps-in-for-Gokhan-Saki-Faces-Saparbeg-Safarov-at-UFC-London-150791|title=Nicolae Negumereanu Steps in for Gokhan Saki, Faces Saparbeg Safarov at UFC London|date=March 2019 |publisher=sherdog.com}}\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n \nThe following fighters will be awarded $10,000 bonuses:\n*'''Fight of the Night:''' Islam Meshev vs. Nashkho Akhmat]] \n|date=April 27, 2019\n|venue=[[VTB Ice Palace]]\n|city={{flagicon|RUS}} [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]\n|attendance= \n|gate= \n|previousevent=\n|followingevent= \n}}\n\n'''''Absolute Championship Akhmat 95: Tumenov vs. Abdulaev''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Absolute Championship Akhmat on April 27, 2019 at the [[VTB Ice Palace]] in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\nAzam Gaforov was scheduled to face Yunus Evloev for the vacant [[Absolute Championship Akhmat#Flyweight Championship|ACA Flyweight Championship]], but Gaforov was forced off the card on march 4 with an injury. Josiel Silva served as Gaforov replacement.\n\nBatraz Agnaev was scheduled to fight against Cory Hendricks but Hendricks suffered an injury during training and was forced to withdraw from the fight. Evgeniy Egemberdiev has stepped in on short notice against Agnaev.\n\nRasul Mirzaev has suffered fingers injury during training and has been unable to compete, that forced his fight against Felipe Froes to be cancelled.\n\nAlexander Peduson was supposed to face Fatkhidin Sobirov. However, Peduson suffered an injury during training and was forced to withdraw from the fight. Cleverson Silva has stepped in on short notice against Sobirov.\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n \nThe following fighters will be awarded $10,000 bonuses:\n*'''Fight of the Night:''' Beslan Ushukov vs. \n}}\n\n'''''Absolute Championship Akhmat 97: Goncharov vs. Johnson 2''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Absolute Championship Akhmat on August 31, 2019 at the [[Basket-Hall Krasnodar|Basket-Hall]] in [[Krasnodar]], [[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\n[[Hacran Dias]] was to challenge Yusuf Raisov at this event, but had to withdraw due to undisclosed reasons. He was replaced by Joao Luiz Nogueira, who stepped in on short notice for this encounter.\n\nArbi Agujev was scheduled to face Bruno Santos, but Agujev was forced off the card due to undisclosed reasons. Vycheslav Babkin served as Agujev's replacement.\n\nA featherweight bout between Adlan Bataev and Mukhamed Kokov was previously scheduled for ACA 97. However, Kokov pulled out of the fight due to weight issues and the bout was scrapped.\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n \nThe following fighters will be awarded $10,000 bonuses:\n*'''Fight of the Night:''' Goga Shamatava vs. Azamat Kerefov\n*'''Knockout of the Night:''' Apti Bimarzaev\n*'''$5000 Stoppage Victory Bonuses:''' Islam Meshev, Nasrudin Nasrudinov, Denis Smoldarev, Vyacheslav Babkin, Aleksei Butorin, Nikola Dipchikov\n\n===Results===\n{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"font-size: 80%;\"\n|-\n! colspan=\"8\" style=\"background-color: #ccf; Akhmat]] \n|date=July 11, 2020\n|venue=[[Sibur Arena]]\n|city={{flagicon|RUS}} [[Saint Petersburg]], [[Russia]]\n|attendance= \n|gate= \n|previousevent=\n|followingevent= \n}}\n\n'''''Absolute Championship Akhmat 106: Frolov vs. Magomedov''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Absolute Championship Akhmat. The event was initially scheduled to be held on March 24, 2020, at the [[Sibur Arena]] in [[Saint Petersburg]], [[Russia]], but it was postponed to July 11, 2020, due to the [[COVID-19 outbreak|coronavirus outbreak]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/ACA-Reschedules-or-Postpones-Three-Events-in-Russia-and-Poland-172084|title=ACA Reschedules or Postpones Three Events in Russia and Poland|author=Dmytro Synyak|publisher=sherdog.com|date=March 31, 2020}}\n\n===Background===\nThis event was headlined by former [[M-1 Global#M-1 Global Middleweight Championship|M-1 Middleweight Champion]] Artem Frolov and Ibragim Magomedov.\n\nA welterweight bout between Magomedsaygid Alibekov and Georgiy Kichigin was scheduled for the co-main event of the evening. However, Kichigin was pulled from the event after testing positive for COVID-19. The welterweight bout between Andrey Koshkin and Mark Hulme was also scheduled for the main card, but Hulme was unable to compete due to visa issues. Alibekov and Koshkin faced each other in the co main event.\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n \nThe following fighters were awarded $10,000 bonuses:\n*'''Fight of the Night:''' Bibert Tumenov vs. Alexander Matmuratov \n*'''Knockout of the Night:''' Bekhruz Zukhurov\n*'''Submission of the Night:''' Egor Golubtsov\n*'''$5000 Stoppage Victory Bonuses:''' Alexey Efremov\n\n===Results===\n{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"font-size: 80%;\"\n|-\n! As a result of this, promotion officials rescheduled the bout for ACA 110 event September 5, 2020.\n\nAlexey Shaposhnikov and Sheikh-Mansur Khabibulaev dropped out of the card due to injury. Their rivals Aren Hakobyan and Ruslan Abiltarov faced each other on the prelims card.\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n \nThe following fighters were awarded $10,000 bonuses:\n*'''Fight of the Night:''' Nasrudin Nasrudinov vs. Evgeniy Egemberdiev \n*'''Submission of the Night:''' Khaseyn Shaikhaev\n*'''$5000 Stoppage Victory Bonuses:''' Aren Akopyan, Magomed Bibulatov, Magomed Ismailov\n\n===Results===\n{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"font-size: 80%;\"\n|-\n! \n|date=December 18, 2020\n|venue=[[VTB Arena]]\n|city={{flagicon|RUS}} [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]\n|attendance= \n|gate= \n|previousevent=\n|followingevent= \n}}\n\n'''''Absolute Championship Akhmat 116: Froes vs Balaev''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Absolute Championship Akhmat on December 18, 2020, at the [[VTB Arena]] in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\nACA featherweight world champion Felipe Froes missed weight ahead of his fight against Marat Balaev and will not be eligible to retain the belt even if he wins. Felipe Froes was 0.7 kilograms over the limit. The fight will proceed with only Balaev, who weighed-in at 66 kg is eligible to win the title with a victory. If Froes wins the fight, the title will become vacant.{{cite web |url=https://fighttime.ru/news/item/23434-chempion-aca-lishilsya-titula-na-vzveshivanii.html|title=\u0427\u0435\u043c\u043f\u0438\u043e\u043d ACA \u043b\u0438\u0448\u0438\u043b\u0441\u044f \u0442\u0438\u0442\u0443\u043b\u0430 \u043d\u0430 \u0432\u0437\u0432\u0435\u0448\u0438\u0432\u0430\u043d\u0438\u0438|publisher=fighttime.ru}}\n\n[[Brett Cooper (fighter)|Brett Cooper]] was scheduled to face Beslan Isaev in a welterweight bout. However, after making weight, he consulted with his lawyers and decided to refuse fighting because of the [[U.S. Department of Treasury]] and Great Britain's sanctions policy against Kadyrov and any organization owned by him, this including Absolute Championship Akhmat. Under these sanctions, it is illegal for any US citizen to do business with any of these entities, meaning that all American fighters could face fines or jail time if they fight for the organization.{{cite web |url=https://tass.ru/sport/10281975|title=\u0410\u043c\u0435\u0440\u0438\u043a\u0430\u043d\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439 \u0431\u043e\u0435\u0446 \u043e\u0442\u043a\u0430\u0437\u0430\u043b\u0441\u044f \u0432\u044b\u0441\u0442\u0443\u043f\u0430\u0442\u044c \u0432 Absolute Championship Akhmat \u0438\u0437-\u0437\u0430 \u0441\u0430\u043d\u043a\u0446\u0438\u0439|publisher=tass.ru}}{{cite web |url=https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2020/12/16/22178613/us-sanctions-ofac-ramzan-kadyrov-chechnya-sportswashing-mma-politics-karim-zidan-feature|title=The Dictator's Dilemma: How U.S. sanctions will impact Ramzan Kadyrov's MMA aspirations|publisher=bloodyelbow.com}}\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n \nThe following fighters will be awarded $10,000 bonuses:\n*'''Fight of the Night:''' Ibragim Magomedov vs. Championship Akhmat on February 26, 2021, at the [[Krylatskoye Sports Palace|Basket Hall Moscow]] in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event was headlined by a title fight for the ACA welterweight title between 2 formers WFCA welterweight champion and current ACA champ Murad Abdulaev and Abubakar Vagaev.{{cite web |last1=Ole\u015b |first1=Bartosz |url=https://inthecage.pl/abdulaev-vs-vagaev-o-pas-mistrzowski-na-lutowej-gali-aca-118/|title=Abdulaev vs. Vagaev for the championship belt at February's ACA 118|date=11 January 2021 |publisher=inthecage.pl}} Abdulaev have previously beaten Vagaev by knockout at WFCA 53 to win the WFCA welterweight Title.\n\nA rematch between former [[Fight Nights Global#Welterweight Championship|FNG Welterweight Champion]] Georgy Kichigin and Gadzhimurad Khiramagomedov served as the co-main event of the evening.{{cite web |url=https://www.sports.kz/news/eks-chempion-fng-iz-kazahstana-provedet-boy-revansh-s-rossiyaninom|title=\u042d\u043a\u0441-\u0447\u0435\u043c\u043f\u0438\u043e\u043d FNG \u0438\u0437 \u041a\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0445\u0441\u0442\u0430\u043d\u0430 \u043f\u0440\u043e\u0432\u0435\u0434\u0435\u0442 \u0431\u043e\u0439-\u0440\u0435\u0432\u0430\u043d\u0448 \u0441 \u0440\u043e\u0441\u0441\u0438\u044f\u043d\u0438\u043d\u043e\u043c|publisher=sports.kz}} The pairing previously met at [[2017 in Fight Nights Global#Fight Nights Global 65: Asatryan vs. Zhumagulov|Fight Nights Global 65]], where Kichigin defeated Khiramagomedov by split decision to capture the FNG inaugural title.{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/19430863/mma-brothers-russia-allegedly-attack-official-loss|title=Brothers allegedly attack official after one loses fight|work=espn.com|date=21 May 2017 }}\n\nRasul Mirzaev was scheduled to fight Nurbergen Sharipov in a featherweight bout,{{cite web |title=\u0420\u0430\u0441\u0443\u043b \u041c\u0438\u0440\u0437\u0430\u0435\u0432 26 2021, at the [[Sibur Arena]] in [[Saint Petersburg]], [[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event featured a title fight, the reigning [[Absolute Championship Akhmat#Bantamweight Championship|ACA Bantamweight champion]] Daniel Oliveira fought [[Magomed Bibulatov]] in the headliner.{{cite web |title=\u0411\u0438\u0432\u0448 \u0431\u043e\u0435\u0446 \u043d\u0430 UFC \u0449\u0435 \u0441\u0435 \u0431\u0438\u0435 \u0437\u0430 \u0442\u0438\u0442\u043b\u0430\u0442\u0430 \u0432 ACA |url=https://mma.bg/novini/mma-novini/bivsh-boets-na-ufc-shte-se-bie-za-titlata-v-aca |website=mma.bg |access-date=18 February 2021}}\n\nA title bout between former champion Felipe Froes and Magomedrasul Khasbulaev served as the ACA 120 co-main event, the bout was for the vacant ACA Featherweight title.{{cite web |title=ACA 120 tournament will be held in St. Petersburg with spectators \u2013 RT in Russian |url=https://www.en24news.com/e/2021/02/aca-120-tournament-will-be-held-in-st-petersburg-with-spectators-rt-in-russian.html |website=en24news.com |access-date=14 February 2021 }}{{Dead link|date=February 2022 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} The pairing were supposed to have met previously on November 6, 2020, at [[2020 in Absolute Championship Akhmat#ACA 113: Kerefov vs. Gadzhiev|ACA 113]], but Khasbulaev was unable to compete due to a leg injury.{{cite web |last1=SYNYAK |first1=DMYTRO |title=KHASBULAEV EXITS ACA 113 TITLE BOUT, MARAT BALAEV NOW MEETS FELIPE FROES ON DEC. 18 |url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Khasbulaev-Exits-ACA-113-Title-Bout-Marat-Balaev-Now-Meets-Felipe-Froes-on-Dec-18-175940#! |website=sherdog.com |access-date=11 February 2021}} Froes |title=\u0425\u0430\u0441\u0431\u0443\u043b\u0430\u0435\u0432 \u043f\u0440\u043e\u0432\u0435\u0434\u0435\u0442 \u0437\u0430\u0449\u0438\u0442\u0443 \u0442\u0438\u0442\u0443\u043b\u0430 It aired on [[UFC Fight Pass]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event was supposed to be headlined by a flyweight bout between LFA's all-time wins leader Victor \"El Magnifico\" Altamirano and top undefeated Brazilian prospect Carlos \"Tizil\" Mota. HISTORIC 100TH EVENT |url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/lfa-celebrates-historic-100th-event/ |access-date=28 January 2022 |work=FightBook MMA |date=27 January 2021}} However, on February 13, Carlos Mota was pulled from the fight and replaced by Nate Smith.{{cite web |author=Alex Behunin|title=Carlos Mota Out Of LFA 100, Nate Smith Steps Both were eliminated from the tournament.\n\n==ACA 135: Gasanov vs. Dzhanaev==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=ACA 135: Gasanov vs. Dzhanaev\n|image=\n|promotion=[[Absolute Championship Akhmat]] \n|date=January 28, 2022\n|venue=Sports Hall Coliseum\n|city={{flagicon|RUS}} [[Grozny]], [[Russia]]\n|attendance= \n|gate= \n|previousevent=\n|followingevent= \n}}\n\n'''''Absolute Championship Akhmat 135: Gasanov vs. Dzhanaev''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Absolute Championship Akhmat on January 28, 2022 at the Sports Hall Coliseum in [[Grozny]], [[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event featured a title fight for the [[Absolute Championship Akhmat#Middleweight Championship|ACA Middleweight Championship]] between the champion Magomedrasul Gasanov and #3 ranked Abdul-Rahman Dzhanaev as the event headliner.\n\nA match for the vacant [[Absolute Championship Akhmat#Flyweight Championship|ACA Flyweight Championship]] between #2 ranked [[Murad Zeinulabidov|Murad Zeynulabidov]] and #4 ranked Imran Bukuev was planned as the event co-headliner.{{cite web |last1=Dorff |first1=Marcel |title=Two title bouts on ACA 135 Grozny |url=https://mobile.twitter.com/ACA_League/status/1468666354161135622 |website=ACA MMA |access-date=11 December 2021}} However, has Zeynulabidov to withdraw from the fight due to an injury suffered during his training camp. the bout was canceled.{{cite web |title=Due to the fact that Murad Zeynulabidov suffered an injury that does not allow him to enter the championship fight against Imran Bukuev |url=https://vk.com/chechen.ultimate.fighters?w=wall-73236394_11358 |website=CHECHEN COMBAT ACADEMY |access-date=29 January 2022}}\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded \n|previousevent=\n|followingevent= \n}}\n\n'''''Absolute Championship Akhmat 136: Bukuev vs Akopyan''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Absolute Championship Akhmat on February 26, 2022, in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]].\n\n===Background===\nThe main event was set to feature a welterweight title fight, the reigning ACA Welterweight Champion Abubakar Vagaev was set to defend his title against Ustarmagomed Gadzhidaudov. However, Vagaev has to withdraw on January 26 due to [[COVID-19]].{{cite web |title=Abubakar Vagaev fell ill with coronavirus and will not be able to take part in the ACA136. |url=https://vk.com/fc_akhmat?w=wall-75444015_92231 |website=FIGHT CLUB AKHMAT |access-date=29 January 2022}} The bout between Imran Bukuev and Aren Akopyan was prompted to the main event of the evening, the fight was for the vacant ACA Flyweight championship. The belt was vacated when [[Azamat Kerefov]] officially announced on October 3, 2021, that he voluntarily vacated the title to try free agency.{{cite web |last1=Vesyoly |first1=Vitaliy |title=Azamat Kerefov leaves ACA bantamweight championship belt vacant |url=https://www.championat.com/boxing/news-4472169-azamat-kerefov-ostavil-poyas-chempiona-aca-v-legchajshem-vese-vakantnym.html |website=championat.com |access-date=11 December 2021 |language=russian}}\n\nA welterweight bout between Vitaliy Slipenko and Stefan Sekuli\u0107 was scheduled as the co-main event. Sekuli\u0107 stepped in as a replacement for Mark Hulme, who withdrew from the bout.{{cite web |title=Stefan Sekuli\u0107 spa\u0161ava me\u010d na ACA 136 u Moskvi! |url=https://triangletv.rs/stefan-sekulic-spasava-mec-na-aca-136-u-moskvi/vesti/mma/regionalni-mma/ |website=triangletv.rs |access-date=17 February 2022}}\n\n'''Bonus awards:'''\n\nThe following Alliance promotion|date=2016-09-19|website=MMAjunkie|language=en|access-date=2019-01-02}}\n\n==Background==\nOn January 7, 2026, it was announced that the promotion has officially parted ways with [[UFC Fight Pass]] and signed a new broadcast deal with [[Vice TV]], which will air 25 events in 2026. This marking a significant shift for the regional promotion as the UFC also cut ties with several other regional partners.{{Cite web |last=Heck |first=Mike |date=2026-01-07 |title=LFA gets new TV home after parting ways with UFC Fight Pass |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/latest-news/465082/lfa-gets-new-tv-home-after-parting-ways-with-ufc-fight-pass |access-date=2026-01-09 |website=MMA Fighting |language=en-US}}\n\nOn October 20, 2026, it was announced a multi-year partnership deal with [[FloSports]] for North American streaming, which will begin [[#LFA 244: Woodley vs. Havener|LFA 244]] to events in December 2026, followed the 25 events in 2027.{{Cite web |date=2026-10-20 |title=LFA Adds FloCombat Streaming Deal Covering 2026\u20132027
